qualification_boundary.reason: The oracle performs NumPy tensor work on CPU. It does not execute through Vulkan or ANE and produces no backend trace, so it does not satisfy plan section 3.3 or the zero-CPU-tensor-dispatch gate.
qualification_boundary.encoder_and_full_plan: not claimed; Linux H13 compile, physical runtime execution, encoder numerical parity, local decoder/joint, TDT output, stability, and packaging remain separate gates

review_remediation: The mel CLI returns failure when any structural gate is false. Root reproduced a boolean mask passing all seven gates before requiring int32 mask identity and float32 encoder bit identity; test_mel_cli_rejects_wrong_mask_dtype now rejects that case. Both real CLIs passed after the correction.
Stage equality requires matching shape, dtype, and bytes; signed-zero-only differences report a bitwise divergence without crashing.
The repository lock authenticates waveform.npy, mel.npy, the exact stage manifest, and all 14 required stage tensors.
The recovered DFT imports the certified single-rounded float32 FMA from dotpr instead of keeping a double-rounding duplicate.
Complex DFT inputs assign real and imaginary components separately so negative-zero bits survive packing.
The fixed DFT frontend rejects inputs outside float32 [batch,512].
